title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #83 February 1986 Comics - Dave Sim - ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #83 February 1986 comic book, written by Dave Sim, features the character Cerebus in the superhero genre. This vintage comic from the Copper Age (1984-1991) is a part of the Cerebus series published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. With its unique storyline, artwork, and historical significance, this comic is a valuable collectible for fans of US Comics and comic book enthusiasts alike.
